description: This file provides wrapper functions for interacting with storage, specifically for saving and retrieving robot test files and run artifacts. It includes functions for saving files, fetching files, and generating presigned URLs for artifacts in a testing management system.

methods.name: str save_robot_file(file_data: bytes, test_file_id: int, filename: str)
methods.description: Saves a robot test file to storage with the specified test file ID and filename.

methods.name: str save_run_artifact(file_path: str, run_id: int, artifact_type: str)
methods.description: Saves a run artifact (log, output, report) to storage, determining file extension and content type based on artifact type.

methods.name: bytes get_robot_file(storage_path: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a robot test file from storage given its path.

methods.name: dict get_run_logs(run_id: int)
methods.description: Generates presigned URLs for accessing run artifacts such as logs, output, and report files.

ctags.name: save_robot_file
ctags.pattern: /^def save_robot_file(file_data: bytes, test_file_id: int, filename: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: save_run_artifact
ctags.pattern: /^def save_run_artifact(file_path: str, run_id: int, artifact_type: str) -> str:$/
